svg.title: Ac: crystalline peak area
svg.desc: Illustrative background-corrected XRD pattern. Green regions show Ac, the sum of crystalline peak areas above the fitted amorphous contribution. Gold shows Aa, the amorphous area above the corrected zero baseline. Their sum is At. Example integrated areas are 60, 40, and 100 arbitrary area units.
